scope: manifest-gated EC2 solve-worker assembly and guest-control identity handling

tests.command: uv run pytest tests/test_sandbox.py tests/test_worker_runtime.py tests/test_operations_deployment.py

assertions: STS assumed-role ARN is matched to the manifest IAM role by partition, account and role name
a mismatched role, account, non-role principal, template manifest or non-solve supervisor cannot assemble the AWS solve worker
the AWS worker provider receives only the solve supervisor's distinct lane templates, subnets and security groups
the guest SSH private key is fetched by its exact environment-and-role secret reference, written to a mode-0600 temporary file on POSIX, and removed after use
Terraform reconciliation compares the declared guest-control identity references with the secret ARNs
limitations: This is a worker assembly library layer; the production worker CLI/container image and administrative worker registration flow remain unimplemented.
No staging account, AMI, launch-template configuration, host known-hosts file, identity secret value or spend authorization is present, so no deployment was attempted.
